overview_description.description:
The abuse of the inbox by commercial email senders is a problem that can be remedied, so we created Glider, a service that filters commercial emails away from your inbox. 

We believe one of the greatest challenges faced by the growing population of knowledge workers in the modern workforce is to combine the advantages of email used for conversational and commercial purposes.
